planRows.censusName: Canopy by Hilton Cancun La Isla
planRows.directoryName: Canopy by Hilton Cancun La Isla
planRows.shortDesc: Embrace the energy of Cancun with a stay next to La Isla Mall. Our thoughtfully curated hotel offers a vibrant stay just steps from the area's best nightlife, shopping, beach clubs, and more. Relax at our on-site spa and enjoy our rooftop lounge for stunning views of the lagoon, poolside drinks, and live music.
planRows.headline: A vibrant stay in Cancun
planRows.locationShortDesc: Located on Avenida Kukulcan in Cancun’s hotel zone, with direct access to Plaza La Isla’s luxury shops and stunning views of Nichupté Lagoon
planRows.hotelTeaserText: Stay in the Heart of Style! Nestled in Cancun’s chicest hotel zone, steps from Plaza La Isla’s luxury avenue and top shopping spots. Unwind in our 'Just the Right Room' bedrooms or sip cocktails on our rooftop with stunning views of the iconic Ferris wheel and Nichupté Lagoon
planRows.directionsTo:
From Cancun Airport: Take the Cancun Airport Highway and follow it for 1.18 miles, continue through Punta Nizuc - Cancun for 10.56 miles, and then turn left. The hotel will be on the right side.

From the North (ADO Cancun Bus Station): Go to the Northeast, taking Pino Av. (223.09 feet), then turn right (262.46 feet), At the roundabout, take the fifth exit and join Uxmal Av. towards Nader Av. / Hotel Margaritas / Radisson (1148.29 feet), At the roundabout, Take the 2nd exit and continue along Uxmal Av. (984.25 feet), then turn right towards Bonampak Av. (2788.71 feet), At the roundabout, take the third exit towards Kukulcan Blvd. (7.64 miles), turn right and your the hotel will be at your right hand.

From Mexico City: Follow through 150D Mexico, 145D Mexico and Minatitlan-Mundo Nuevo / 180D Mexico  towards Cardenas - Coatzacoalcos / Coastal Gulf Road / Coatzacoalcos - Villahermosa / 180 E Mexico at Veracruz. Take the exit toward Villahermosa / 180D Mexico - Minatitlan-Mundo Nuevo / 180D Mexico.

From Merida City: Continue on Costera del Golfo E Road / Merida - Valladolid / 180 E Mexico to Kantunil-Cancun / 180D Mexico. (39.27 miles); Continue on Kantunil-Cancun / 180D Mexico towards 180 QROO in Quintana Roo. Take the exit towards Xel-Ha-Kantunil-Cancun / 180D Mexico  (140.43 miles); Continue on 180 QROO  and Punta Nizuc - Cancun to your final destination in , Cancun Zona Hotelera (20.87 miles).

From Playa del Carmen: Take 12th Bis North Street and 50 North Av. toward 50 South Av. / Cancun - Tulum Road/ 307 Mexico. (0.93 miles); Continue on Cancun - Tulum Road / 307 Mexico towards Punta Nizuc - Cancun. Take the exit toward Zona Hotelera of Cancun - Tulum Road / 307 Mexico (31.75 miles); Keep Forward Punta Nizuc – Cancun Road to your final destination in Cancun Zona Hotelera (10.31 miles).

planRows.censusName: Canopy by Hilton Sao Paulo Jardins
planRows.directoryName: Canopy by Hilton Sao Paulo Jardins
planRows.shortDesc: Embrace the vibrant energy of São Paulo at our hotel located in the Jardins district. We're within a 20 minute walk of Ibirapuera Park, Paulista Avenue, Oscar Freire Street shops, and museums. We offer complimentary Canopy Bikes and WiFi. Savor authentic Brazilian fare at our all-day restaurant, serving a delicious Saturday feijoada buffet.
planRows.headline: A stylish stay in the Jardins district
planRows.locationShortDesc: Canopy by Hilton Sao Paulo Jardins is in the heart of Jardins, an upper-class neighborhood at the most multicultural city of South America.
planRows.directionsTo:
Get on Rod. Pres. Dutra-Pista Lateral from BR-610. Head east on R. Interna do Aeroporto Internacional de Guarulhos. Turn left. Keep left and merge onto BR-610. Use the right lane to take the ramp to Guarulhos/Via Dutra/Rod. Fernão Dias

Continue on Rod. Pres. Dutra-Pista Lateral to Santana, São Paulo. Merge onto Rod. Pres. Dutra-Pista Lateral. Keep left. Continue straight. Slight right onto Av. Morvan Dias de Figueiredo. Continue straight to stay on Av. Morvan Dias de Figueiredo. Use the 2nd from the right lane to stay on Av. Morvan Dias de Figueiredo.
 
Take Corredor Norte-Sul and Av. Santos Dumont to Corredor Norte-Sul/Av. Prestes Maia in Centro Histórico de São Paulo. Use the right lane to stay on Av. Morvan Dias de Figueiredo. Continue onto Av. Assis Chateaubriand. Use the right lane to take the Ponte das Bandeiras ramp. Merge onto Corredor Norte-Sul/Pte. das Bandeiras. Use the left 3 lanes to turn slightly left onto Av. Santos Dumont. Keep left to continue on Corredor Norte-Sul/Av. Santos Dumont.

Follow Corredor Norte-Sul to Rua Coronel Oscar Porto in Paraíso. Take the exit toward R. Tutóia/Jardins from Av. 23 de Maio/Corredor Norte-Sul. Keep left to continue on Corredor Norte-Sul/Av. Prestes Maia. Keep left to continue on Corredor Norte-Sul. Keep left to continue on Av. 23 de Maio/Corredor Norte-Sul. Take the exit toward R. Tutóia/Jardins.

Continue on Rua Coronel Oscar Porto. Drive to Av. Brigadeiro Luís Antônio in Jardim Paulista. Slight right onto Rua Coronel Oscar Porto (signs for V. Mariana/Av. Paulista/Consolação). Continue onto Rua Chris Tronbjerg. Turn left onto Av. Brigadeiro Luís Antônio.
